claims.scope: battleElo rating update in EloCalculator using Elo.ratingChange

preconditions.text: battleElo processes a single battle result and calls Elo.ratingChange(eloB, eloA, ...) to obtain change and negative for one party.; negative is true, signifying eloB's rating should decrease.; negative is false, indicating eloB's rating should increase.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: When negative is true, eloB should decrease by change and eloA should increase by change; when negative is false, eloA should decrease and eloB should increase, so the better-performing party's rating rises and the worse-performing party's rating falls.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。

effects.text: Protocol functionality relying on the calculated Elo ratings (rankings, matchmaking, reward distribution, eligibility determination) operates on entirely incorrect data.
effects.derivation: 该影响保留在覆盖清单中，但未生成形式化谓词。

assumptions: battleElo is the only path that applies the change and negative values to the simulated eloA and eloB scores.
The better-performing party is identified by the battle outcome, not by the sign of the returned change value.
Downstream protocol functionality (rankings, matchmaking, rewards, eligibility) consumes the simulated Elo ratings produced by battleElo.

limitations: The selected impact severe_consequences is a potential downstream consequence; its predicate is a grounded Boolean over the report's stated incorrect-data outcome rather than a numeric ranking/reward relation.
Direction of adjustment is formalized qualitatively because the report supplies no numeric elo or change values.
Only the severe_consequences impact is formalized here; direction_inverted and dependent_functions_wrong_data are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
